description: An empty stock file makes parse_stock raise JSONDecodeError; the fix belongs in storage.py.

issue.title: Starting up with an empty stock file crashes
issue.body:
After a fresh install the stock file is empty and the app dies on start:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/inventory/app.py", line 5, in main
    return load_stock(path)
  File "/srv/inventory/service.py", line 7, in load_stock
    return parse_stock(text)
  File "/srv/inventory/storage.py", line 6, in parse_stock
    data = json.loads(text)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/decoder.py", line 355, in raw_decode
    raise JSONDecodeError("Expecting value", s, err.value) from None
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

An empty file should just mean there is no stock yet.
